95741 - Akoman In YC128, as the stability of Pochven wavered, the Blood Raiders saw an opportunity to plunder the region for the secrets of Triglavian biotech. The Akoman was constructed to help them take advantage of that opportunity.

Facing off against an inarguably more advanced foe, the Blood Raiders needed a vessel that represented the best of their own technical prowess. This attack battlecruiser allowed Blood Raider fleets to form stronger frontline assaults as they struck at the heart of Triglavian territory.		 Attack Battlecruiser

95745 - Akoman Alliance Emblem Emblems by Paragon bring new light to your ship personalization.

By accessing your registered identity data, these nanoholographic projections emblazon your favorite vessels with symbols that matter to you. And now, by utilizing the latest in cloud-based AI synchronization, emblems remain stable even during warp.

Visit your nearest IRIS and take part in Paragon's latest initiatives to unlock new emblems today.

Paragon; be more.

Second repeated-time totality cycle in drift. Lystopad phase unresolved, renewal advanced-time uncertainty. Azdaja interference resulting in drift. Stability is now-time uspevat, fitness is now-time uspevat.

Poshlost in proximity to the flow must suffer extirpation. Glorified in proximity to the flow must face proving or suffer extirpation. Only fitness guarantees advanced-time stability.		 Triglavian Entities

97638 - Decayed Capital Remote Armor Repairer Mutaplasmid This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool is designed to interface with and alter standard, assembler-based remote armor repair systems. As such this mutaplasmid could be used to mutate the performance characteristics of most remote armor repairers in the correct size class.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool has begun to decay and mutation effects will be less pronounced as a result. While possible mutational benefits are low, the risks of using this mutaplasmid are also reduced.		 Mutaplasmids

97639 - Unstable Capital Remote Armor Repairer Mutaplasmid This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool is designed to interface with and alter standard, assembler-based remote armor repair systems. As such this mutaplasmid could be used to mutate the performance characteristics of most remote armor repairers in the correct size class.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool is highly unstable, with a high rate of reproduction and mutation. The mutational benefits of using this mutaplasmid are potentially very high but the risks are also extreme.		 Mutaplasmids

97650 - Decayed Large Remote Armor Repairer Mutaplasmid This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool is designed to interface with and alter standard, assembler-based remote armor repair systems. As such this mutaplasmid could be used to mutate the performance characteristics of most remote armor repairers in the correct size class.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool has begun to decay and mutation effects will be less pronounced as a result. While possible mutational benefits are low, the risks of using this mutaplasmid are also reduced.		 Mutaplasmids

97659 - Triglavian Pilot <font size="14">Triglavian Pilot Expert System</font>

This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly Triglavian Tech 1 frigate-type, destroyer-type, cruiser-type, battlecruiser-type and battleship-type ships along with Triglavian-focused supporting skills.

The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days.

An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump.

<font size="14">Activating an Expert System</font>

Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service.

Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.		 Standard Expert Systems

97712 - Zorya’s Ultratidal Entropic Disintegrator This extra-large Entropic Disintegrator is only seen in use on Triglavian capital ships, these massive ships being capable of managing the considerable radiation and enormous gravitational tidal forces the weapon generates. At the energy levels of this ultraheavy weapon system, the tidal forces are so powerful that even the special systems built into battleships are insufficient and only capital ships can deal with the forces involved.

Entropic Disintegrators draw on the tremendous power of the Triglavian singularity-based energy systems to convert exotic matter into a particle stream directed with locally generated entropic force. While powerful, the range of the weapon is limited by the attenuation of entropic forces, which dissipate critically beyond the optimal range. As a result this weapon has no falloff range.

The particle stream generates thermal and explosive reactions on impact, and the entropic forces resolve into a localized gravitational conduit that steadily increases the acceleration on the exotic particles. In effect, the weapon's damage potential increases to a maximum level as long as the particle stream is kept on the same target.

Requires either standard or advanced exotic plasma charge ammo types: Baryon, Meson, Tetryon, Mystic, and Occult.		 Precursor Weapon

1048547 In YC128, as the stability of Pochven wavered, the Blood Raiders saw an opportunity to plunder the region for the secrets of Triglavian biotech. The Akoman was constructed to help them take advantage of that opportunity.

Facing off against an inarguably more advanced foe, the Blood Raiders needed a vessel that represented the best of their own technical prowess. This attack battlecruiser allowed Blood Raider fleets to form stronger frontline assaults as they struck at the heart of Triglavian territory.		 In YC128, as the stability of Pochven wavered, the Blood Raiders saw an opportunity to plunder the region for the secrets of Triglavian biotech. The Akoman was constructed to help them take advantage of that opportunity.

1053978 <font size="14">Wormhole Pilot Expert System</font>

This Expert System makes available the skills a capsuleer needs to fly a gas-harvesting Venture, all Covert Ops frigates, and use combat fittings for a Praxis ready for Class 3 wormholes.

The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days.

An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump.

<font size="14">Activating an Expert System</font>

Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service.

Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.		 <font size="14">Wormhole Pilot Expert System</font>

1054714 The Order of St. Tetrimon is an Amarr religious order known for its fanatical followers and radical scriptural, theocratic, and militarist doctrines. The Order is named for St. Tetrimon, an Ardishapur noble who assassinated his grandfather the Emperor Zaragram II, in response to the increasingly megalomaniac and heretical actions of the "Mad Emperor". 1054882 Inside the Criterion, the convocation of Triglav outside the struggle will determine fitness based on survival success. Inside the Criterion, the convocation of Triglav outside the struggle will determine fitness based on survival success.
1054883 Inside the Criterion, the Convocation of Triglav Outside the Struggle will determine fitness based on survival success.

Access must be earned. Criterion Cipher can be earned from Crimson Harvest sites to unlock the acceleration gate. The key is consumed on use, and the gate locks behind those who enter.

The Criterion consists of three combat trials. Speed of completion determines fitness, fitness improves rewards. Challenges are dynamic. Superior capsuleer performance will lead to more dangerous encounters, but also greater rewards.

Time to complete: 15-30 minutes.
Hostiles: Triglavians.
Size: 1 pilot.
Roles: Enforcer.
Modules: Smart Bombs cannot be used within the site.
Ship Restrictions: A well-fitted battlecruiser to survive, a marauder to excel.		 Inside the Criterion, the Convocation of Triglav Outside the Struggle will determine fitness based on survival success.

1055315 Decayed Capital Remote Armor Repairer Mutaplasmid Decayed Capital Remote Armor Repairer Mutaplasmid Name of item 97638 (Mutaplasmids)
1055316 This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool is designed to interface with and alter standard, assembler-based remote armor repair systems. As such this mutaplasmid could be used to mutate the performance characteristics of most remote armor repairers in the correct size class.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool has begun to decay and mutation effects will be less pronounced as a result. While possible mutational benefits are low, the risks of using this mutaplasmid are also reduced. 1055434 Triglavian Pilot Triglavian Pilot Name of item 97659 (Standard Expert Systems)
1055435 <font size="14">Triglavian Pilot Expert System</font>

This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly Triglavian Tech 1 frigate-type, destroyer-type, cruiser-type, battlecruiser-type and battleship-type ships along with Triglavian-focused supporting skills.

The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days.

An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump.

<font size="14">Activating an Expert System</font>

Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service.

Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.		 <font size="14"><b>Triglavian Pilot Expert System</b></font>

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

1055700 The Blood Raider Covenant is a particularly gruesome sect of Sani Sabik cult. While all modern Sani Sabik rituals use blood in some manner or another, the Blood Raiders Covenant places particular value on it, and will go to great lengths to acquire it from what they believe to be the richest and most unspoiled sources. They are considered among the most dangerous and depraved of all pirate elements operating in space. The Blood Raider Covenant is a particularly gruesome sect of Sani Sabik cult. 1055752 Zorya’s Ultratidal Entropic Disintegrator Zorya’s Ultratidal Entropic Disintegrator Name of item 97712 (Precursor Weapon)
1055753 This extra-large Entropic Disintegrator is only seen in use on Triglavian capital ships, these massive ships being capable of managing the considerable radiation and enormous gravitational tidal forces the weapon generates. At the energy levels of this ultraheavy weapon system, the tidal forces are so powerful that even the special systems built into battleships are insufficient and only capital ships can deal with the forces involved.

Entropic Disintegrators draw on the tremendous power of the Triglavian singularity-based energy systems to convert exotic matter into a particle stream directed with locally generated entropic force. While powerful, the range of the weapon is limited by the attenuation of entropic forces, which dissipate critically beyond the optimal range. As a result this weapon has no falloff range.

The particle stream generates thermal and explosive reactions on impact, and the entropic forces resolve into a localized gravitational conduit that steadily increases the acceleration on the exotic particles. In effect, the weapon's damage potential increases to a maximum level as long as the particle stream is kept on the same target.

Requires either standard or advanced exotic plasma charge ammo types: Baryon, Meson, Tetryon, Mystic, and Occult.
